description: This file defines a React component for the Marketplace Journey Page within a Next.js project. It includes UI components, state management, and placeholder data for a recommendation and opportunity marketplace, connected to a user's roadmap and skill gaps.

methods.name: safeParseRoadmapState
methods.description: Parses the JSON string from localStorage to extract RoadmapState with error handling.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamps a number between specified min and max values.

methods.name: completionSummary
methods.description: Computes summary of milestones, including counts of done, in progress, and not started.

methods.name: countSkillGapsFromDeltas
methods.description: Analyzes deltas to determine completed, in-progress, and missing skills for the current role plan.

methods.name: usePrefersReducedMotion
methods.description: Custom React hook for detecting user preference for reduced motion.

methods.name: BadgePill
methods.description: A small badge component with color variants for display labels.

methods.name: MetricCard
methods.description: UI component displaying a metric with label, value, and status tone.

methods.name: OpportunityCard
methods.description: UI component representing an opportunity with details like title, provider, skills, ratings, and interaction buttons.

methods.name: MarketplaceJourneyPage
methods.description: Main React component rendering the marketplace page, including sections for career context, recommendations, skill gaps, and exploration opportunities, with responsive animations and localStorage integration.
